Three moves can lift operating profit by a fifth within two years
The market grew 6% a year since 2021, but our share slipped from 18% to 15% as two new competitors priced below us.
Most of the lost share sits in two segments where our offer is strong but our coverage is thin and our prices are hard to compare.
Winning back half the lost share is worth about four points of margin; standing still costs a further point a year.
Reprice the core range, double coverage in the two segments, and simplify the offer to three packages.
A 12-week pilot in one region, a team of six, and a decision on pricing authority by the end of the month.
